svg.aria-label: How OWUI Agent connects: the agent in VS Code sends every request through one egress guard, which allows only your Open WebUI server; Open WebUI serves your model and, if you enable it, web search through your SearXNG. Requests to any other host are refused. The optional browser tool opens only localhost pages in your own Chrome or Edge. Commands you approve run in your own shell, outside the guard.
